notes.title: V1.8 version update : Added support for Gamepad.
notes.notes:
V1.8 version update content:

[h1]Added support for Gamepad.[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39389214/e9f0759af5eef14820e20cb77c31e246ff92057d.png[/img]

. You can Dash in all arm modes.
. You can Block in all arm modes.
. Improve the smoothness of skill connection.
. Significantly increase the durability of the Blade mode.
. Improve the sensitivity of the key combination.
. Fixed the saves bug and some other bugs.
